initiative-tutorial:
Initiative
Each turn, both Pokémon gain Initiative based on their speed stats. When a player matches 4 or more tiles in a row, they get a free turn.
error-cant-switch-status: A status effect prevents this Pokémon from switching out.
error-cant-switch-fear-frozen: Your active Pokémon is too frozen in fear to retreat!
error-cant-switch-magnet-pull: Your active Pokémon is held in place by magnetic force.
pokemon-move-requirement-level: Your Pokémon needs to be at least level %c% to use this move.
pokemon-move-requirement-level-error: Your Pokémon needs to be at least... wait, they're high enough level. Huh????
ask-to-rename-pokemon: What would you like to name your %c%?
error-cant-remove-last-pokemon: You can't put your only Pokémon into the PC.
error-cant-delete-box-isnt-empty: You can't delete a non-empty box because, like, I don't know where to put those poor homeless Pokémon.
error-cant-delete-no-boxes-left: This is your only box left. Please make a new one first.
error-no-usable-pokemon: All your Pokémon are currently fainted.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey, hey! ^^$@blue|Welcome!@$^^

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Thanks for tryin' this little game. Not to go tooting horns, but this to^^ok $@red|A LOT!@$$@wait-10|@$ of ^^effort.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: That's a nice %c-pname% you got there! Let's see how they are in a friendly match!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Aww, you got me! That was a tough fight! Hey, tell me when you want to have another go at it, alright?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Hey, no worries! You can't win them all.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: I heard some Pokémon are better against others, anyway. I can't wait for next time!

effects.speaker: Jimmy
effects.text: Hey, you! Check out my cool dog!

effects.speaker: Audrey
effects.text: Hey, thanks for not telling my brother that his Pokémon isn't a dog. I know that took restraint.

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Oh, hey again! Have you caught any new Pokémon?

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: You've caught %c% Pokémon!

effects.speaker: Kevin
effects.text: Hey, have you seen my big sister? She said she was coming with Gully... oh well! Let's have a battle while we wait!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Y'know how Wingull are always stealing your snacks on the beach?

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: I've got a little secret for you!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: It was the same Wingull every time.

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Gully here has been single-handedly making people buy a new order of fries for years.

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: He's a $@start-italics|@$smart$@end-italics|@$ little kleptomaniac, isn't he?

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: But now you that know my secret... I can't let you go telling people about it!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: Arghhh! Fine, you beat me! But please, don't tell anyone about Gully's crimes!

effects.speaker: Madison
effects.text: He's a sweet little horrible thing! Just... keep this between us, okay?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Hello...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Will you...
Will you...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Could you please...
Could you please...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^Um... I'm really sorry to bother you, but...
Um... I'm really sorry to bother you, but...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: ^^My name is Lillie.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I... I need help getting to the trainers' school. It's just a little further... but there are so many mean-looking Pokémon up ahead!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I don't want to be late... ^^Oh, I can give you one of the professor's spare $@red|Pokédex@$es^^ for your trouble!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Phew...$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Thank you so much for helping me out there.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I'll get out of your hair. The professor probably needs me, anyway. Thank you again!

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Oh! ^^Before I go! This school is having a special lesson today.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Ms. Emily wants their students to get some practice battling Pokémon with other trainers! You should help her out!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: Did I hear that right?! Are you guys part of today's lesson?!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: I^^ can't wait! I've even been^^ working on a cool thing tor me and my Pokémon to say!^^

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$*ahem*$@end-italics|@$$@wait-10|@$
*ahem*

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: They say the early bird gets the worm...... but I hope it also wins this battle!

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: Aww, dang. But be honest, was my line at least a $@start-italics|@$little$@end-italics|@$ cool?

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: Yay, my turn my turn! Uh... me and my Pokémon are gonna $@start-italics|@$rock$@end-italics|@$ your world!

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$A^^wwwwww...$@end-italics|@$ Mister Wobbles wobbled too hard...

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: Alright, lemme show you two how it's $@start-italics|@$really$@end-italics|@$ done!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: This Pokémon I caught yesterday is practically invincible!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: How did you defeat my unbeatable strategy?! I guess I should teach Podzilla more moves...

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Hmph. What was your plan there, Joey? Just let your Metapod get squashed?

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Let me take a swing at them. Sit back and watch a future Pokémon champion at work!

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$What?!$@end-bold|@$ How the heck did— How did I lose?! That— that can't be right!

effects.speaker: Joseph
effects.text: Grrr... Maybe I need to train more. I'm gonna be the champion one day!

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Oh, there you are, Joseph. And Hiromi, Joey, Mia... wait, is everyone already finished? What happened?

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Oh! You're not the trainer I was expecting... but, judging by all these fainted Pokémon, I think I can guess what happened.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Well, no harm done. The lesson was about battling, and thanks to you, they got $@start-italics|@$plenty$@end-italics|@$ of experience.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Since everyone's already battled... I guess there's no harm in one last match, right? Think of it as... $@start-italics|@$extra credit$@end-italics|@$.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Whew$@end-italics|@$... You really know how to keep a class on their toes.

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Well, that's everyone in the school. You've got some skills.

effects.speaker: Hiromi
effects.text: I'm gonna make up more cool battle lines!

effects.speaker: Mia
effects.text: Me and Mister Wobbles are gonna be just as good as you when we grow up!

effects.speaker: Joey
effects.text: I just looked up what Metapod evolves into, I think I'm gonna have to rename him soon...

effects.speaker: Emily
effects.text: Yes, even though you weren't the special guest I was expecting, you certainly helped quite a bit. I hope he's alright...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Hey, uh... sorry to interrupt, but the professor and I are finished.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Apparently he's got something planned for later today... but anyway, he asked about you. Sorry, you just came up in conversation...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: Anyway, he wants me to take you to Hau'oli City. I think he thinks you're doing the island challenge thing? I don't know...

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I can take you there, if you'd like.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: Some time later...

effects.speaker: The Masked Royal
effects.text: Alright! Who's ready to throw down?!

effects.speaker: The Masked Royal
effects.text: Where'd everybody go?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Why hello! You don't look like you're from here, if you don't mind my saying so. How are you enjoying Hau'oli city?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Am I correct in assuming you're visiting to partake in the island challenge?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: You $@start-italics|@$suppose$@end-italics|@$ so? That's not often the response I'm accustomed to hear—

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Yo, yo, yo! Look who we found out and about! Tryna act tough? Well, knock it out!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Y'all talk big with your island trial, but here's Team Skull to cramp your style!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: It's island $@start-italics|@$challenge$@end-italics|@$, actually. Anyway, %c%, if we may continue—

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Hey! Hold up! We're challengin' ya here!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Yeah, c'mon! You're supposed to be all intimidated with the boot-quakin' and stuff!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Oh, $@start-italics|@$fine$@end-italics|@$... if you must. %c%, may I have you deal with these two for me?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: In the meantime, I will be doing anything else.^^ Be back soon!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Man... this always happens, B. Why's this $@start-italics|@$always$@end-italics|@$ gotta happen?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: I know, I know... but like, maybe we shouldn't be jumpin' people who are right next to the best trainer in the city?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: $@start-bold|@$Fiiiine$@end-bold|@$... you told me so, is that what you wanna hear?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Let's just leave before that pompous prince gets back and starts like, givin' us battle tips or somethin'.

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt A
effects.text: Yeah, you guys got lucky this time! Next time we'll bring THREE guys, then whatcha gonna do?!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt B
effects.text: Three guys! The magic number! You guys don't stand a chance!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: Is Ilima coming back?

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I think he's over there shopping.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: I'll go get him...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: (Yes, I'm coming, I'm coming... how are you so strong?)

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Hello again. In recognition of your efforts, I am obliged to battle with you so as to test your worth in the island challenge, and what have you.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only captain Ilima!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well done! That was certainly a battle.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I mean no offense, but I $@start-italics|@$was$@end-italics|@$ going easy on you, since you helped with those thugs.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Maybe one day, we'll be able to have another battle.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Would you mind helping me with something, dear?

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: I'm working to create a very special perfume. A $@start-italics|@$signature scent$@end-italics|@$ of mine.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: I find that, if my $@red|perfume@$ battles, her scent becomes... more appealing. It helps to release those $@start-italics|@$richer$@end-italics|@$ notes.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: The last time she battled, her scent gained these ^^wonderful^^ whiffs of lavender.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Let's see what new scents she can unlock from battling $@start-italics|@$you!$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Oof... that scent is downright overbearing.

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: Wait, do I detect a hint of^^...^^ just $@start-italics|@$what$@end-italics|@$ is this new texture in her aroma?

effects.speaker: Krystal
effects.text: That's... heavenly! Thank you, dear. Once I get my baby back into shape, she'll produce the most sought-after, limited-edition scent in Alola!

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: Howdy! I just saw you while I was setting up my camp for the night.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: I'm all set for the night, now! So, wanna battle while the sun's still up?

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: I don't have a lot of Pokémon, I packed light. All I've got is Soozle, here.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: We've been camping together for years! She makes a $@start-italics|@$great$@end-italics|@$ pillow.

effects.speaker: Ashley
effects.text: Aw, dang. Well, I guess she'll be pretty tired tonight. Let's get you rested up, okay?

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: You decide not to have a trainer battle in the cemetery because something tells you that these trainers might not be interested right now.

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Hey! You, uh— trainer person! You look like you've got some strong Pokémon! I need your help, come on!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: A bunch of those weird Skull guys are making a ruckus on the berry farm! Pa's trying to drive them out, but they just won't take a hint!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Yo, I'm not gonna say it again, old man— hand over the berries!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt D
effects.text: Yeah, hand 'em over! Us Team Skull guys got a sweet tooth!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: These berries ain't for people. I'd be happy to give them to any Pokémon for free, but never to thieves like you!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: So you're saying I'm lower than a Pokémon? I already got self-esteem issues, man!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: This here's a berry farm, not a free sample station. Now get, before I let out the Tauros!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Pa, I brought backup! Stranger, think you could help drive these pests out for us?

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Man... we lost again?! All we wanted was a couple berries, and maybe, like... mild bragging rights!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt D
effects.text: Bro, we're outta Pokémon, we're outta berries... and now we're even outta our league! This stinks!

effects.speaker: Team Skull Grunt C
effects.text: Let's get outta here before the old man^^ makes us mulch!

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Whew, that was incredible! Thanks stranger, you were a real help!

effects.speaker: Jay
effects.text: Yep, if you ever want something, come on down to the farm and we'll give you as many berries as you'd like.

effects.speaker: Ikue
effects.text: Maybe one day that line'll be important if I ever decide to program held items into this thing! Don't hold your breath!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Ah, welcome, challenger! You're just in time for the commencement of the Trial of Melemele Island's Verdant Cavern!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Which, yes, may $@start-italics|@$technically$@end-italics|@$ consist of nothing more than a small rodent infestation, but don't let that diminish the gravity of the task!

effects.speaker: Hau
effects.text: $@start-italics|@$Ooooh,$@end-italics|@$ are we fighting a boss already?! I can't wait!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: No... it's really just a few Yungoos and Rattata...$@wait-20|@$ ^^oh, he's already gone. Look, can I be honest with the two of you?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Look, there's nothing exciting in that cave. I'm paid to oversee something that feels special, and this cave thing definitely works for $@start-italics|@$some$@end-italics|@$ people, but...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I mean, it's literally just 3 Rattata. One of them's a little bigger than the others.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: This whole thing is just a formality, I just need to check that you're $@start-italics|@$capable$@end-italics|@$ trainers, not stupid ones.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Let's just have a battle, instead. I've got some more capable Pokémon on me.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Oh. Well, alright. Have fun, I guess. I'll be waiting out here.
effects.label: skipTo

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Ah, you've returned victorious! I could practically $@start-italics|@$feel$@end-italics|@$ the energy of your climactic battle coming from the cave.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Now, with your triumph over this trial, I am $@font-size:0.6|@$mildly enthused$@font-size:1|@$ to present the three of you with these emblems as proof of your mastery.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I didn't do anything...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Nonsense! Young lady, you endured the $@start-italics|@$bone-chilling$@end-italics|@$ atmosphere of the Verdant Cavern! And, quite honestly, I ordered these in bulk.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well done! That was quite invigorating. I daresay that you've earned your passage— not through pest control, but through panache!

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I should really offer this little opportunity to more trial-goers. As it stands, I have to wait here until... whoever that other child was finishes.

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: I really must start imposing time limits on trial attempts. Maybe install signage?

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Well, it's no matter now. Here, both of you, take these emblems as proof of your passage.

effects.speaker: Lillie
effects.text: But I didn't do anything...

effects.speaker: Ilima
effects.text: Young lady, I am close to certain that you could defeat 3 rats. Please just take the emblem.

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: The traveler paused at a crossroads, unaware of the trial fate had laid before them...

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: That trial... was me. ^^Tatiana.$@wait-10|@$ Rising star.$@wait-10|@$ Future champion.$@wait-10|@$ Heroine of a saga still unfolding!

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: You've wandered into the as-of-yet-unwritten chapter seven, page one: $@start-italics|@$The Duel of Destiny$@end-italics|@$.

effects.speaker: Tatiana
effects.text: Let's make it a good one! Feel free to throw in some plot twists— let the battle begin!

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: You round a corner along the path, and see a trainer walking two Pokémon on leashes.

effects.speaker: Narrator
effects.text: One leash is taut, dragging behind him, and the other is flapping constantly, as the Pokémon races around the trainer.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: Rockruff, $@start-italics|@$heel!$@end-italics|@$ Slowpoke, $@start-italics|@$hurry!$@end-italics|@$

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: I'm just trying to walk my Pokémon, but they're making it $@start-italics|@$so$@end-italics|@$ hard.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: It's $@start-italics|@$supposed$@end-italics|@$ to be good for bonding, but it's more like being dragged around by one and $@start-italics|@$trying$@end-italics|@$ to drag the other.

effects.speaker: Makana
effects.text: Care for a battle? Rockruff really needs to vent some energy, and my arms are starting to hurt.

Absorb.name: Absorb
Absorb.description: Deals damage. Then, heals the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

Air Cutter.name: Air Cutter
Air Cutter.description: Deals damage. The user chooses a tile. Then, that tile and a V-shaped selection around it are removed.
Air Cutter.choose: Choose a tile to cut a V-shape around.

Assurance.name: Assurance
Assurance.description: Deals damage. This move deals double damage if its target was dealt damage earlier this turn.

Astonish.name: Astonish
Astonish.description: Deals damage. Then, removes half of the target's initiative.
Astonish.shortDescription: Deals light damage and slows opponent

Aqua Jet.name: Aqua Jet
Aqua Jet.description: Deals damage. If the opponent has any benched Pokémon remaining, this move also attacks one of them of your choice, with 20 less power.
Aqua Jet.choose-pokemon: Choose a Pokémon for Aqua Jet to deal damage to.

Baby-Doll Eyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
Baby-Doll Eyes.description: Lowers the opponent's attack stat by 1 stage. Then, the opponent becomes unable to switch Pokémon for a turn.
Baby-Doll Eyes.shortDescription: Lowers enemy attack and prevents switching

Bide.name: Bide
Bide.description: After two turns, this move deals damage equal to the opponent equal to twice the damage received since it was used. The user can't use moves in the meantime.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description: Deals damage. Then, the user chooses up to a 2x2 area of tiles. A 2x2 area around those tiles are each removed.
Bite.shortDescription: Deals some damage and removes tiles
Bite.choose: Choose up to 4 tiles in a 2x2 square.

Bubble Beam.name: Bubble Beam
Bubble Beam.description: Deals damage. Gives 8 random non-Water tiles the Bubbly status effect. Being Bubbly adds 1 blue energy to the tile's energy value.

Bug Bite.name: Bug Bite
Bug Bite.description: Deals damage. Then, drains 2 energy from the opponent's three most full energy types and gives it to the user.
Bug Bite.shortDescription: Deals some damage and drains energy

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description: Raises the user's special defense stat by 1 stage. The power of the next Electric-type move the user uses is doubled.

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description: Lowers the opponent's attack stat by 1 stage.

Confuse Ray.name: Confuse Ray
Confuse Ray.description: Applies Confused. Then, the user chooses a tile. A 3x3 area of tiles centered around that tile are shuffled.

Confusion.name: Confusion
Confusion.description: Deals damage. Then, 50% of the time, applies Confused.

Copycat.name: Copycat
Copycat.description: Uses the effects of the move the opponent most recently used. If they haven't used a move, this move does nothing.

Covet.name: Covet
Covet.description: Deals damage. Then, drains 6 energy from the opponent's two most full energy types and gives it to the user.

Curse.name: Curse
Curse.description: If the user is Ghost type, applies Cursed to one random tile. Otherwise, lowers the user's Speed by one stage, and raises their Attack and Defense by one stage each. At the start of the opponent's turn, if any tiles are Cursed, they take damage equal to 1/4 of their max HP.

Defense Curl.name: Defense Curl
Defense Curl.description: Raises the user's defense stat by 1 stage.
Defense Curl.shortDescription: Raises defense and buffs other moves

Disable.name: Disable
Disable.description: Disables the move used most recently by the opponent for 10 turns.

Disarming Voice.name: Disarming Voice
Disarming Voice.description: Deals damage. Has a 50% chance to confuse the opponent. Ends the turn.
Disarming Voice.shortDescription: Deals light damage and may confuse

Double Team.name: Double Team
Double Team.description: Raises the user's speed stat by 1 stage. Then, makes a random match somewhere on the board without ending the user's turn.

Dragon Breath.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon Breath.description: Deals damage. Then, 50% of the time, applies Paralyzed.

Echoed Voice.name: Echoed Voice
Echoed Voice.description: Deals damage. This move's yellow energy cost is reduced by 6 during your next turn.

Ember.name: Ember
Ember.description: Deals damage. There's a 50% chance for this move to inflict Burn on 3 random tiles for 5 turns. At the start of each turn, the opponent takes damage for each Burned tile on the board.

Fairy Wind.name: Fairy Wind
Fairy Wind.description: Deals damage. Then, shifts a row of the user's choice 3 tiles to the right.
Fairy Wind.shortDescription: Shifts a row to the right

Fake Out.name: Fake Out
Fake Out.description: Deals damage, then ends the turn. As long as the user has been the active Pokémon for more than two turns, this move's purple energy cost increases by 7.

Fake Tears.name: Fake Tears
Fake Tears.description: Lowers the opponent's special defense stat by 2 stages.

Feint.name: Feint
Feint.description: Removes the Invulnerable status from the opponent. Then, deals damage.

Flatter.name: Flatter
Flatter.description: Applies Confused to the opponent. However, the opponent's Special Attack is raised a stage. After a Confused Pokémon uses a move, there's a 50% chance for their turn to end.
Flatter.shortDescription: Confuses the opponent but buffs them

Focus Energy.name: Focus Energy
Focus Energy.description: Raises the user's attack stat by 2 stages.

Fury Attack.name: Fury Attack
Fury Attack.description: At the end of your turn, deals damage a number of times equal to the number of matches made that turn (max 5).

Fury Swipes.name: Fury Swipes
Fury Swipes.description: Deals damage. If this is the first time Fury Swipes was used this turn, its orange and yellow energy costs are reduced by 1.

Growl.name: Growl
Growl.description: Lowers the opponent's attack stat by 1 stage.

Growth.name: Growth
Growth.description: Raises the user's attack stat by 1 stage. Then, 3 random Grass tiles are selected. Tiles diagonally adjacent to those tiles become Grass tiles.

Gust.name: Gust
Gust.description: Deals damage. Then, shifts the entire board away from the user by 1 tile.

Harden.name: Harden
Harden.description: Gives the user the Invulnerable status for one turn. It can't take damage for as long as it has that status. Then ends the turn.

Haze.name: Haze
Haze.description: Removes all status effects from the opponent.

Helping Hand.name: Helping Hand
Helping Hand.description: Reduces the cooldown of the move with the user's highest cooldown by 5.

Hone Claws.name: Hone Claws
Hone Claws.description: The next time that Pokémon uses a move which shares a type with it, the greatest color component(s) in that move's cost is reduced by 4.

Howl.name: Howl
Howl.description: This Pokémon's energy gain is increased by 50% until their next turn.

Hyper Fang.name: Hyper Fang
Hyper Fang.description: Deals damage. Then, removes 30 initiative from the opponent.

Hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
Hypnosis.description: Has an 80% to apply Sleep to the opponent. Otherwise, it will apply Drowsy. When a Drowsy Pokémon ends their turn, they may become Asleep, and lose Drowsy. An Asleep Pokémon gets half as much energy (rounded up) from matches.

Infestation.name: Infestation
Infestation.description: Deals damage. Converts a random tile into a Grass tile and gives it the Infested status. At the start of the opponent's turn, for each Infested tile, that tile drains 1 energy of a random color, and gives it to the user.

Leafage.name: Leafage
Leafage.description: Deals damage. 3 random tiles are transformed into Grass tiles.
Leafage.shortDescription: Damages and turns tiles into Grass tiles

Leer.name: Leer
Leer.description: Lowers the opponent's defense stat by 1 stage.

Lick.name: Lick
Lick.description: Deals damage. Lowers the chance of Grass tiles spawning by 50%, and makes Dark tiles more likely to spawn instead. Dark tiles are worth 1 purple energy AND 1 red energy each.
Lick.shortDescription: Deals light damage and spawns Dark tiles

Low Kick.name: Low Kick
Low Kick.description: Deals damage. This move's power depends on the weight of the target. Its power is 20 against Pokémon which are less than 10kg, 40 when less than 25kg, 60 when less than 50kg, 80 when less than 100kg, 100 when less than 200kg, and 120 when greater than 200kg. This move is the only reason that I programmed in weights for Pokémon.

Mean Look.name: Mean Look
Mean Look.description: Applies Frozen in Fear. A Frozen in Fear Pokémon can't be switched out by any means.

Mega Drain.name: Mega Drain
Mega Drain.description: Deals damage. Then, heals the user for 50% of the damage dealt.

Minimize.name: Minimize
Minimize.description: Until the start of the user's next turn, their damage-dealing moves have their costs halved (rounded up), and their power reduced by 25%.

Metal Claw.name: Metal Claw
Metal Claw.description: Deals damage. Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Attack by a stage.

Mud-Slap.name: Mud-Slap
Mud-Slap.description: Deals damage. 2 random tiles are given the Energy Down status. When an opponent removes those tiles, they're worth 1 less energy each.

Nasty Plot.name: Nasty Plot
Nasty Plot.description: Raises the user's special attack stat by 2 stages.

Nuzzle.name: Nuzzle
Nuzzle.description: Deals damage. Applies Paralyzed. When a Paralyzed Pokémon uses a move, the move does nothing, and they lose Paralyzed.

Pay Day.name: Pay Day
Pay Day.description: Replaces all Electric tiles on the board with Rainbow tiles. Then deals damage, and ends the turn.

Payback.name: Payback
Payback.description: Deals damage. If the user's speed stat is less than the speed stat of their opponent, this move's power increases by 50.

Peck.name: Peck
Peck.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects. Ends the turn.

Play Nice.name: Play Nice
Play Nice.description: Lowers the opponent's attack stat by 1 stage. Then, the user chooses two tiles. Those tiles are swapped.

Pluck.name: Pluck
Pluck.description: Deals damage. Then, drains half of the energy from the opponent's tmost full energy type and gives it to the user.
Pluck.shortDescription: Deals some damage and drains energy

Poison Fang.name: Poison Fang
Poison Fang.description: Deals damage and has a 50% chance to poison the target. If the target was already poisoned, instead it deals damage with 20 additional power.
Poison Fang.shortDescription: Deals some damage and might poison

Poison Gas.name: Poison Gas
Poison Gas.description: Has a 90% chance to apply poisoned to the opponent.

Poison Powder.name: Poison Powder
Poison Powder.description: Applies the Poison Powder status to 5 random tiles. At the start of each turn, if there are 20 or more tiles with Poison Powder, all but one Poison Powder is removed and the opponent falls asleep. At the start of each turn, for each tile adjacent to a tile with Poison Powder, that tile has a 7% chance to gain Poison Powder.

Poison Sting.name: Poison Sting
Poison Sting.description: Deals damage. Then, has a 30% chance to apply poisoned to the opponent.
Poison Sting.shortDescription: Deals small damage and might poison

Pound.name: Pound
Pound.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects. Ends the turn.

Present.name: Present
Present.description: 80% of the time, this move deals damage to the opponent with power ranging from 40-120. Otherwise, it heals the opponent for 25% of their max HP or maxes out their energy.

Pursuit.name: Pursuit
Pursuit.description: Deals damage. If the opponent has been active for no more than 1 turn, this move's power doubles.

Quick Attack.name: Quick Attack
Quick Attack.description: Deals damage. This move can be used more than once during a turn.

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.description: The opponent must swap to a different Pokémon if possible. Then ends the turn.
Roar.choose-pokemon: Choose a Pokémon to swap to.

Rock Smash.name: Rock Smash
Rock Smash.description: Deals damage. The user chooses a tile. All tiles of the same type connected in a contiguous group are removed.
Rock Smash.shortDescription: Removes a chain of same-color tiles

Rock Throw.name: Rock Throw
Rock Throw.description: Deals damage. The user chooses a tile. All tiles in that column are removed.

Sand Attack.name: Sand Attack
Sand Attack.description: A random diamond-shaped area of tiles are given the Energy Down status. When an opponent removes those tiles, they're worth 1 less energy each.

Scratch.name: Scratch
Scratch.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects. Ends the turn.

Seismic Toss.name: Seismic Toss
Seismic Toss.description: Deals damage exactly equal to the user's level.

Shadow Sneak.name: Shadow Sneak
Shadow Sneak.description: Deals damage. If you and your opponent have a different number of Pokémon remaining, this move's power increases by 40.

Sketch.name: Sketch
Sketch.description: This Pokémon learns how to use the move the opponent most recently used. If they haven't used a move, this move does nothing.

Sleep Powder.name: Sleep Powder
Sleep Powder.description: Applies the Sleep Powder status to 5 random tiles. At the start of each turn, if there are 20 or more tiles with Sleep Powder, all but one Sleep Powder is removed and the opponent falls asleep. At the start of each turn, for each tile adjacent to a tile with Sleep Powder, that tile has a 10% chance to gain Sleep Powder.

String Shot.name: String Shot
String Shot.description: Lowers the opponent's speed stat by 2 stages.

Struggle.name: Struggle
Struggle.description: An attack of desperation only useful when there are no available moves. It also deals recoil damage to its user equal to 1/4 their max HP, before ending the current turn.

Stun Spore.name: Stun Spore
Stun Spore.description: Applies the Stun Spore status to 5 random tiles. At the start of each turn, if there are 20 or more tiles with Stun Spore, all but one Stun Spore is removed and the opponent is paralyzed. At the start of each turn, for each tile adjacent to a tile with Stun Spore, that tile has a 10% chance to gain Stun Spore.

Super Fang.name: Super Fang
Super Fang.description: Deals damage equal to half the target's remaining HP.

Supersonic.name: Supersonic
Supersonic.description: Applies Confused. After a Confused Pokémon uses a move, there's a 50% chance for their turn to end.

Sweet Kiss.name: Sweet Kiss
Sweet Kiss.description: Applies Confused. Then, shuffles the board. After a Confused Pokémon uses a move, there's a 50% chance for their turn to end.

Swift.name: Swift
Swift.description: Deals damage. This move can be used more than once during a turn.

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description: Damage-dealing move with no special effects. Ends the turn.

Tail Whip.name: Tail Whip
Tail Whip.description: Lowers the opponent's defense stat by 1 stage.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: The user swaps to a different Pokémon if possible.
Teleport.choose-pokemon: Choose a Pokémon to teleport in.

Thunder Shock.name: Thunder Shock
Thunder Shock.description: Deals damage. 2 random tiles are given the Static status effect. When the user removes a tile with Static, it explodes orthogonally adjacent tiles as well.

Thunder Wave.name: Thunder Wave
Thunder Wave.description: A random column of tiles is given the Static status effect. When the user removes a tile with Static, it explodes orthogonally adjacent tiles as well.

Vise Grip.name: Vise Grip
Vise Grip.description: Deals damage. Then, if the target is still active, the user chooses a tile. That tile becomes Locked for 10 turns. Other trainers can't swap Locked tiles.

Water Gun.name: Water Gun
Water Gun.description: Deals damage. This move's power increases by 2 for every Water tile on the board.

Wing Attack.name: Wing Attack
Wing Attack.description: Deals damage. Then, a random line is chosen such that the line passes through the center of the board and has an angle between -45 and 45 degrees. All tiles with a distance of 0.5 or less from that line are removed.

Wrap.name: Wrap
Wrap.description: Gives 2-5 tiles on the board the Wrap status. When an opponent removes those tiles, this move deals them damage.

Yawn.name: Yawn
Yawn.description: Applies Drowsy. When a Drowsy Pokémon ends their turn, they may become Asleep, and lose Drowsy. An Asleep Pokémon gets half as much energy (rounded up) from matches.

No Ability.name: No Ability
No Ability.longDescription: This Pokémon has no ability. This is probably because I am slow.

Adaptability.name: Adaptability
Adaptability.shortDescription: Moves that match this Pokémon's type deal twice as much damage.
Adaptability.longDescription: The bonus applied to move damage caused by that move matching this Pokémon's types is increased from x1.5 to x2.

Aftermath.name: Aftermath
Aftermath.shortDescription: On fainting from a move that makes contact, damage the attacker for 1/4 their max HP
Aftermath.longDescription: When this Pokémon faints from damage caused by a move that makes contact, it deals damage to the attacker equal to 1/4 the attacker's HP.

Analytic.name: Analytic
Analytic.shortDescription: Raises move power while slower than the opponent
Analytic.longDescription: As long as the opponent has a higher effective Speed than this Pokémon's moves have their power raised by 30%.

Anger Point.name: Anger Point
Anger Point.shortDescription: Maxes out Attack when the opponent matches 5+ tiles in a row.
Anger Point.longDescription: When the opponent makes a match of 5 or more tiles in a row, this Pokémon's Attack increases by 6 stages.

Battery.name: Battery
Battery.shortDescription: Increases special move power of this trainer's Pokémon by 30%, even while this Pokémon isn't active.
Battery.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is in your party and still usable, the power of all special moves its trainer's Pokémon use is increased by 30%.

Big Pecks.name: Big Pecks
Big Pecks.shortDescription: Other Pokémon can't lower this Pokémon's Defense stages
Big Pecks.longDescription: Other Pokémon can't give this Pokémon status effects which lower its Defense stat by any number of stages.

Blaze.name: Blaze
Blaze.shortDescription: Fire moves are stronger at low health
Blaze.longDescription: Fire moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
Chlorophyll.shortDescription: On a non-Grass match, adds some green energy anyway
Chlorophyll.longDescription: Each match this Pokémon makes that contains no Grass tiles provides green energy equal to 1/3 the greatest amount of one color of energy added, rounded down.

Comatose.name: Comatose
Comatose.longDescription: This Pokémon counts as being Asleep at all times.

Compound Eyes.name: Compound Eyes
Compound Eyes.shortDescription: On a match that doesn't combo, raises Special Attack 1 stage 50% of the time
Compound Eyes.longDescription: At the end of this Pokémon's turn, if it makes only one match of exactly three tiles, this ability has a 50% chance to raise its Special Attack by 1 stage.

Defiant.name: Defiant
Defiant.shortDescription: Raises this Pokémon's Attack 1 stage when its opponent lowers its stats
Defiant.longDescription: When this Pokémon receives a debuff from another source that lowers its stats, its Attack is increased by 1 stage.

Early Bird.name: Early Bird
Early Bird.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon gains the Asleep status, its duration is halved, rounded up.

Flare Boost.name: Flare Boost
Flare Boost.shortDescription: Raises move power while tiles are burned
Flare Boost.longDescription: As long as at least one tile has the Burn status, this Pokémon's moves have their power increased by 50%.

Flash Fire.name: Flash Fire
Flash Fire.shortDescription: Raises Fire move power when hit with a Fire move
Flash Fire.longDescription: When this Pokémon is dealt damage by a Fire-type move, the power of Fire-type moves it uses is raised by 50%.

Flower Veil.name: Flower Veil
Flower Veil.shortDescription: Prevents any stat debuffs being put on this trainer's Grass Pokémon
Flower Veil.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, Grass Pokémon owned by this Pokémon's trainer can't have their stats lowered by stages.

Forewarn.name: Forewarn
Forewarn.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, the weight of Psychic tiles is increased by 0.5. (The normal weight is 1)

Friend Guard.name: Friend Guard
Friend Guard.shortDescription: Prevents damage to this trainer's other Pokémon while this Pokémon is out
Friend Guard.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, damage can't be dealt to non-active Pokémon owned by this Pokémon's owner.

Gluttony.name: Gluttony
Gluttony.shortDescription: Heals when it's too full to gain energy
Gluttony.longDescription: When this Pokémon would gain energy but doesn't while its energy is too full, it heals 1 HP for each energy not gained.

Guts.name: Guts
Guts.shortDescription: Increases move power by 50% while this Pokémon has a status condition
Guts.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon has a non-volatile status effect, the power of all of its moves is increased by 50%.

Honey Gather.name: Honey Gather
Honey Gather.longDescription: The energy value of 4-in-a-row matches is increased by 50%.

Hustle.name: Hustle
Hustle.shortDescription: Raises Attack by 50%, but adds a random extra cost to moves each turn
Hustle.longDescription: This Pokémon's Attack stat is increased by 50%. However, at the beginning of this Pokémon's turn, each of its moves have a random additional cost added.

Hydration.name: Hydration
Hydration.shortDescription: On a Water-type 4-in-a-row, cures one random status
Hydration.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 Water tiles in a row, this Pokémon recovers from one non-volatile status that it has.

Hyper Cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
Hyper Cutter.shortDescription: Other Pokémon can't lower this Pokémon's Attack stages
Hyper Cutter.longDescription: Other Pokémon can't give this Pokémon status effects which lower its Attack stat by any number of stages.

Infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
Infiltrator.shortDescription: This Pokémon can deal damage through Invulnerable
Infiltrator.longDescription: Damage from this Pokémon is able to pass through the Invulnerable status effect.

Inner Focus.name: Inner Focus
Inner Focus.longDescription: If an effect would set this Pokémon's initiative to a lower value, it's prevented.

Insomnia.name: Insomnia
Insomnia.longDescription: This Pokémon can't be put to sleep during battle.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.shortDescription: Lowers the enemy's Attack a stage when it enters.
Intimidate.longDescription: When this Pokémon is put into play, it lowers the opponent's Attack by a stage.

Iron Fist.name: Iron Fist
Iron Fist.shortDescription: This Pokémon's punching moves get +20% power
Iron Fist.longDescription: The power of punching moves used by this Pokémon are increased by 20%.

Justified.name: Justified
Justified.shortDescription: Raises Attack a stage when hit with a Dark-type move
Justified.longDescription: When this Pokémon is dealt damage by a Dark-type move, its Attack is increased by a stage.

Keen Eye.name: Keen Eye
Keen Eye.shortDescription: Resistant to cost-raising effects from other Pokémon
Keen Eye.longDescription: The effects of statuses imposed by other Pokémon which raise the costs of this Pokémon's moves are reduced by 50%.

Leaf Guard.name: Leaf Guard
Leaf Guard.shortDescription: Prevents receiving status effects from opponent based on green energy
Leaf Guard.longDescription: If this Pokémon receives a status effect from another trainer, it has a chance to prevent it equal to 50% of how full its green energy is.

Levitate.name: Levitate
Levitate.longDescription: If this Pokémon would be dealt damage by a Ground-type move, that damage is reduced to 0.

Liquid Voice.name: Liquid Voice
Liquid Voice.longDescription: Sound-based moves that this Pokémon uses are treated as though they were Water moves.

Lightning Rod.name: Lightning Rod
Lightning Rod.longDescription: As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, the weight of Electric tiles is increased by 0.5. (The normal weight is 1)

Long Reach.name: Long Reach
Long Reach.longDescription: Moves that this Pokémon uses don't count as making contact.

Magic Guard.name: Magic Guard
Magic Guard.longDescription: If this Pokémon would take non-fixed damage from something other than an effect of a move, that damage is reduced to 0.

Magnet Pull.name: Magnet Pull
Magnet Pull.longDescription: The opposing Pokémon can't retreat as long as it's Steel-type and this Pokémon is active.

Moody.name: Moody
Moody.longDescription: At the end of each turn, this Pokémon has a random one of its stats raised by 2 stages, then a random other stat decreased by 1 stage.

Natural Cure.name: Natural Cure
Natural Cure.shortDescription: On switching out, cure all statuses
Natural Cure.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon's user switches it out, all of its status conditions are cured.

Oblivious.name: Oblivious
Oblivious.shortDescription: Can't have energy drained by other Pokémon
Oblivious.longDescription: If an effect of another Pokémon's move would remove energy from this Pokémon, that energy drain is reduced to 0.

Overcoat.name: Overcoat
Overcoat.shortDescription: Spore and Powder moves don't affect this Pokémon
Overcoat.longDescription: When Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, or Poison Powder trigger, this Pokémon isn't affected by them.

Overgrow.name: Overgrow
Overgrow.shortDescription: Grass moves are stronger at low health
Overgrow.longDescription: Grass moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Own Tempo.name: Own Tempo
Own Tempo.longDescription: This Pokémon can't be confused during battle.

Pickup.name: Pickup
Pickup.shortDescription: Gets some energy from the opponent's 4-in-a-row matches
Pickup.longDescription: When the opponent makes a 4-in-a-row match, this Pokémon gets some energy as well. The energy added is equal to 1/4 of the energy added by that match and any matches made simultaneously with it, rounded.

Poison Touch.name: Poison Touch
Poison Touch.shortDescription: Poisons the attacker when they make contact 30% of the time
Poison Touch.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, this ability has a 30% chance to apply Poisoned to the attacker.

Power of Alchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
Power of Alchemy.shortDescription: Copies the ability of the most recently fainted Pokémon.
Power of Alchemy.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon owned by this Pokémon's trainer faints, this Pokémon gains that fainted Pokémon's ability.

Prankster.name: Prankster
Prankster.longDescription: Status moves this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Rain Dish.name: Rain Dish
Rain Dish.shortDescription: On a Water-type 4-in-a-row, heals 20% of max HP
Rain Dish.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 Water tiles in a row, this Pokémon heals HP equal to 20% of its max HP.

Rattled.name: Rattled
Rattled.shortDescription: Raise Speed a stage when hit with Bug, Ghost, or Dark moves
Rattled.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon is dealt Bug-, Ghost-, or Dark-type damage, its Speed is increased by 1 stage. This also triggers whenever another Pokémon uses Intimidate against this Pokémon.

Regenerator.name: Regenerator
Regenerator.shortDescription: On switching out, heal based on how long it was active
Regenerator.longDescription: Whenever this Pokémon's user switches it out, it heals HP based on how many turns it was active.

Rock Head.name: Rock Head
Rock Head.longDescription: Moves that deal recoil damage to their user don't deal recoil to this Pokémon.

Run Away.name: Run Away
Run Away.shortDescription: Raises Speed 2 stages if damaged last turn
Run Away.longDescription: At the end of each turn, if this Pokémon was dealt damage during that turn, its Speed stat is raised 2 stages during the next turn.

Sand Veil.name: Sand Veil
Sand Veil.shortDescription: On a Fighting-type 4-in-a-row, increase Speed a stage
Sand Veil.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 Fighting tiles in a row, this Pokémon's Speed increases by 1 stage.

Sand Force.name: Sand Force
Sand Force.shortDescription: On a Fighting-type 4-in-a-row, increase the power of the next Rock/Ground/Steel move used by 50%
Sand Force.longDescription: When this Pokémon's owner makes a match of 4 Fighting tiles in a row, the power of the next Rock-, Ground-, or Steel-type move this Pokémon uses is increased by 50%.

Serene Grace.name: Serene Grace
Serene Grace.shortDescription: Moves with additional effects cost 30% less
Serene Grace.longDescription: Moves which have additional effects this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Shed Skin.name: Shed Skin
Shed Skin.shortDescription: At the end of its turn, 20% chance to cure one status
Shed Skin.longDescription: At the end of this Pokémon's turn, it has a 20% chance to recover from one non-volatile status that it has.

Sheer Force.name: Sheer Force
Sheer Force.shortDescription: Prevents additional effects, but increases power
Sheer Force.longDescription: When this Pokémon uses a move, if it has additional effects, its power is increased by 30%, but any additional effects of the move are prevented.

Shield Dust.name: Shield Dust
Shield Dust.shortDescription: Prevents receiving status effects from opponent 20% of the time
Shield Dust.longDescription: If this Pokémon receives a status effect from another trainer, it has a 20% chance to prevent it.

Skill Link.name: Skill Link
Skill Link.shortDescription: Increases move power by 5 for each move used earlier this turn
Skill Link.longDescription: The power of moves this Pokémon uses is increased by 5 for each move that it used earlier this turn.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.shortDescription: On a 5-in-a-row, next move's power is doubled
Sniper.longDescription: When this Pokémon makes a 5-in-a-row match during this Pokémon's turn, the power of its next move is doubled.

Stakeout.name: Stakeout
Stakeout.shortDescription: Doubles move power against Pokémon that just switched in
Stakeout.longDescription: Moves that this Pokémon uses against Pokémon which have been active for 2 or fewer turns have their power increased by 100%.

Static.name: Static
Static.shortDescription: Paralyzes the attacker when they make contact 30% of the time
Static.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, this ability has a 30% chance to apply Paralyzed to the attacker.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.shortDescription: Raises Speed a stage when its initiative is lowered
Steadfast.longDescription: When this Pokémon's initiative is lowered, its Speed is increased by a stage.

Strong Jaw.name: Strong Jaw
Strong Jaw.shortDescription: This Pokémon's biting moves get +50% power
Strong Jaw.longDescription: The power of biting moves used by this Pokémon are increased by 50%.

Sturdy.name: Sturdy
Sturdy.longDescription: Damage taken while this Pokémon's HP is full causes it to drop to 1 HP instead.

Super Luck.name: Super Luck
Super Luck.shortDescription: 10% of the time and once per turn, makes its last move used free and reset its cooldown
Super Luck.longDescription: After this Pokémon finishes using a move, 10% of the time, the cooldown for that move is reset to 0, and its next activation this turn costs no energy.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.shortDescription: Bug moves are stronger at low health
Swarm.longDescription: Bug moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Sweet Veil.name: Sweet Veil
Sweet Veil.shortDescription: Prevents sleep. Also, Fairy tiles may spawn. Fairy tiles are worth 1 green AND blue energy.
Sweet Veil.longDescription: This Pokémon can't be put to sleep during battle. As long as this Pokémon is the active Pokémon, the weight of Fairy tiles is increased by 0.5. Fairy tiles are worth 1 green AND 1 blue energy. (The normal weight is 0)

Synchronize.name: Synchronize
Synchronize.shortDescription: Copies received Paralyze and Poisoned statuses for the opponent
Synchronize.longDescription: When this Pokémon receives the Paralyze or Poisoned status effects from an effect of a move, the opponent also gets the same status.

Tangling Hair.name: Tangling Hair
Tangling Hair.shortDescription: Lowers an attacker's Speed when they make contact with this Pokémon
Tangling Hair.longDescription: Whenever another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon through a move that makes contact, the attacker has their Speed reduced by a stage.

Technician.name: Technician
Technician.shortDescription: Moves with power 60 or less have their power raised 50%
Technician.longDescription: Moves that this Pokémon uses which have a power of 60 or less have their power raised by 50%.

Thick Fat.name: Thick Fat
Thick Fat.shortDescription: Reduces damage taken from Fire- or Ice-type moves.
Thick Fat.longDescription: When this Pokémon receives damage from a Fire- or Ice-type move, the attacker's relevant attack stat is reduced by 50%.

Tinted Lens.name: Tinted Lens
Tinted Lens.shortDescription: "Not very effective" moves used do double damage.
Tinted Lens.longDescription: As a move this Pokémon uses deals damage, if the type effectiveness of that damage is 0.5 or less, its damage is doubled.

Torrent.name: Torrent
Torrent.shortDescription: Water moves are stronger at low health
Torrent.longDescription: Water moves that this Pokémon uses while at less than or equal to 1/3 HP have their power increased by 50%.

Triage.name: Triage
Triage.longDescription: Healing moves this Pokémon uses have their energy costs reduced by 30%.

Unburden.name: Unburden
Unburden.shortDescription: Raises Speed a stage when its owner pays exactly as much energy as they have in a color
Unburden.longDescription: Whenever paying for a move causes at least one of this Pokémon's energy colors to fall to become completely empty, its Speed is increased by 1 stage.

Vital Spirit.name: Vital Spirit
Vital Spirit.longDescription: This Pokémon can't be put to sleep during battle.

Weak Armor.name: Weak Armor
Weak Armor.shortDescription: Getting hit with Physical moves lowers Defense by a stage and raises Speed by two stages
Weak Armor.longDescription: When another Pokémon deals damage to this Pokémon with a Physical move, its Defense is lowered by one stage, but its Speed is raised by two stages.

careful.description: Increases this Pokémon's Special Defense and lowers its Special Attack.

drowsy.name: Drowsy

asleep.description: This Pokémon gets half as much energy from matches, rounded up.

fear-frozen.name: Frozen in Fear

Route 1-6.name: Route 1-6
